files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: add_contact
tool_schemas.description: Adds the specified user (by user_name) to the current user’s workspace contacts and returns the created/updated contact entry. It refuses requests missing user_name, with an empty user_name, or when the named user does not exist in the workspace. It also refuses attempts to add a contact that is already in your contacts or that you are not allowed to add (for example, adding yourself).

user_name.description: User name of contact to be added.

tool_schemas.name: delete_message
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a message previously sent in the conversation with the given receiver and returns confirmation of the deletion. It refuses requests missing receiver_id, with an unknown receiver_id, or where the referenced message does not exist. It also refuses deletion when the message is not owned by the current user, does not belong to the specified receiver thread, or is not in a deletable state.

receiver_id.description: User ID of the user to send the message to.

message_id.description: ID of the message to be deleted.

tool_schemas.name: get_message_stats
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregate messaging statistics for the currently logged-in user (for example counts over sent/received and similar totals supported by the service). It refuses the request when there is no active logged-in user context. It may also refuse when the user is not a member of the workspace or their account is not allowed to access messaging statistics.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_id
tool_schemas.description: Looks up a user by user name and returns that user’s ID. It refuses requests missing the user parameter, with an empty name, or where no workspace user matches the provided name. It may also refuse lookups that are not visible to the caller due to workspace membership or privacy restrictions.

tool_schemas.name: list_users
tool_schemas.description: Lists users visible in the current workspace and returns the collection of user records. It refuses the request when there is no active logged-in user context or the caller is not a member of the workspace. It may also refuse when the account lacks permission to enumerate workspace users.

tool_schemas.name: message_get_login_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current messaging login status for the caller (for example whether a user is logged in and which user context is active). It refuses the request when the service cannot determine a caller context. It may also refuse if the workspace session is invalid or expired.

tool_schemas.name: message_login
tool_schemas.description: Logs into the messaging service as the specified user_id and returns the resulting login/session status. It refuses requests missing user_id, with an unknown user_id, or where the user_id is not part of the workspace. It also refuses login when another user is already logged in and switching users is not allowed, or when the target account is not eligible to log in.

user_id.description: User ID of the user to log in.

tool_schemas.name: search_messages
tool_schemas.description: Searches the current user’s accessible message history for the given keyword and returns the matching messages. It refuses requests missing keyword or with an empty keyword. It also refuses when the caller is not logged in or when the user has no permission to search the requested message corpus.

keyword.description: The keyword to search for in messages.

tool_schemas.name: send_message
tool_schemas.description: Sends the provided message to the specified receiver_id and returns the created message record. It refuses requests missing receiver_id or message, with an empty message, or where receiver_id does not resolve to a valid workspace user. It also refuses sending when the caller is not logged in, cannot message the receiver (for example not permitted or not a contact if required), or when messaging is disabled for the sender or receiver.

receiver_id.description: User ID of the user to send the message to.

tool_schemas.name: view_messages_sent
tool_schemas.description: Returns the historical messages sent by the currently logged-in user. It refuses the request when there is no active logged-in user context or the user is not permitted to access message history. It may also refuse when the user is not a member of the workspace or messaging history is unavailable for the account.

metadata.name: Helio Workspace Messenger
metadata.description: A workspace messaging service that manages users and contacts, supports login and sending/searching messages, and provides message history and interaction statistics.
